I wrote `music.mjs` and ran it. It produced `music.wav`, a 16-bit stereo file at 44.1 kHz. I haven't listened to it.

The file is 4,667,141 bytes, which works out to about 26.4 seconds. That is 16 bars at 140 BPM. The arrangement runs as a 2-bar intro, then an A section, a B section and a final lift.

The music is bouncy square-wave and triangle chiptune with a light drum groove. The notes and drum hits wrap around the end of the file onto the start, so the tails carry over when it loops. I haven't checked how the loop sounds at the seam.
